items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clyde Higgins was a saxophone player, right? ... Clyde Higgins came along, and he played – he was a great player. I would say he played better than Willie.

ctx.x: Two names: Clyde Higgins and Mabel Higgins. Do those ring a bell? Saxophone player.
Clyde Higgins was a saxophone player, right?
